content.query:
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CbcCifNumber) AS CbcAclId,
    *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CUST.ORGKEY AS CbcCifNumber,
        NULL AS AclReportDate,
        CASE 
            WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN CMISC.STR20 IN ('BRR1', 'BRR') THEN CMISC.STR21
                    ELSE NULL
                END

            WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN CUST.RISK_RATING_TYPE IN ('BRR', 'BRR1') THEN CUST.RISK_RATING_NAME
                    ELSE NULL
                END
        END AS Brr,
        CASE 
            WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN CMISC.STR20 = 'BSP' THEN CMISC.STR21
                    ELSE NULL
                END

            WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN CUST.RISK_RATING_TYPE = 'BSP' THEN CUST.RISK_RATING_NAME
                    ELSE NULL
                END
        END AS BSPClassification,
        NULL AS CbcAclRemarks,
        NULL AS ImpairmentStage,
        NULL AS TotalFinalAcl
    FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO CMISC
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = CMISC.ORGKEY
    WHERE CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
        AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1
) TEMP
ORDER BY CbcAclId;
